what: The paired-rendition Reference Dataset: 333 pairs of a structured original (a workbook) and its printed rendition (a PDF) whose print shows the workbook as it now stands. The reader under measurement reads only the PDF; the answer key is built from the workbook alone.

origin.selection: of 524 unique pairs, those whose PDF prints the workbook exactly under the reader-independent text check in bootstrap/exactness.py, less the revisions the scorer later found (EXCLUDED.csv)
origin.family_source: Poppler's pdfinfo Producer or Creator, read once when the split was sealed (bootstrap/split.py)

expected_values.how: the workbook's own display strings under its own number formats, built by bootstrap.reference from the workbook bytes with openpyxl, xlrd and SSF (node); the reader reads the PDF with pypdfium2 and pypdf and never sees the workbook
expected_values.shared_dependencies_with_the_reader: none: no parser, table detector or engine is shared between the key and the reader
expected_values.corrections: every correction made to the key is logged in bootstrap/README.md and changed the score without touching the reader
expected_values.caveat: the key is what the workbook displays, not human gold: a pair whose workbook was edited after printing is excluded as a revision, never repaired from the PDF side (ADR-0023)

reference.name: loop-reference-v6
reference.note: the answer keys are not committed; bootstrap.reference rebuilds them and the measurement command refuses any key whose digest is not the retained one

split.grouping_rule: Originals, clean scan twins, degraded twins and closely related revisions stay together across development and holdout. A scan twin of a development workbook is not holdout evidence.
split.note: pairs.json seals the split over all 524 unique pairs; the keys and holdout flags carry over to this subset unchanged, so the 333 pairs are the 524-pair split restricted to the exact set

holdout_policy: The holdout was scored at loop-007 and at loop-020, and again by the 2026-09-06 reproduction inside Corridor; every access is a line of holdout-access.jsonl. Imported holdout cases are spent for the frozen reader. Re-running the frozen implementation is a reproducibility and regression check, not a new generalization claim. Changing the reader after inspecting those outcomes requires a new held-out evaluation for a new generalization claim (ADR-0008). The measurement command refuses a holdout run without an explicit flag, actor and reason, and appends every access it makes, with its result, to the ledger.
gate: every reader cell lands on a reference cell with the same display text
every reference cell in the columns the page maps is present
spans agree with the workbook's merged ranges
every string outside a table is header or footer text
a pair passes when every page passes and every reference cell is exact on some page

value_mismatch.meaning: a reader cell aligned to a reference cell whose display text differs

different.meaning: the reader's text is not the workbook's

format_only.meaning: the same number shown in another format

unicode_variant.meaning: the same text once punctuation variants and case are folded

reader_has_more.meaning: the reader's text contains the reference text and more

reader_has_less.meaning: the reader's text is part of the reference text and nothing on the page explains the cut

clipped_prefix.meaning: the print shows the leading whole words of a wrapped cell Excel cut to the row height, or the start of a row split across pages

clipped_suffix.meaning: the print shows the trailing whole words of a cut cell, or the end of a row split across pages

clipped_middle.meaning: lines hidden above and below: the print shows whole words from the middle of the cell

clipped_evidence.meaning: the shortfall is made up by runs the reader kept as hidden behind a clip, in the cell's column or on its line

clipped_edge.meaning: text cut mid-word at the page edge, a rule, the next cell, the table's edge or a column wall; the reader's cut mark or the geometry proves it

overflow_hashes.meaning: Excel printed hash marks for a number or date wider than its column; the PDF never held the value

rounded_to_width.meaning: a General-format number the column was too narrow to show in full

epoch_zero.meaning: serial 0 shown as 1/0/1900 by Excel and 12/30/1899 by LibreOffice

missing_value.meaning: a reader cell aligned to a reference cell holds no text

outside_table.meaning: the text is on the page, outside every table

in_table_elsewhere.meaning: the text appears in another cell of the table

absent.meaning: the text is nowhere on the page

missing_cell.meaning: a reference cell in a mapped column has no reader cell in its aligned row

outside_table.meaning: the text is on the page, outside every table

in_table_elsewhere.meaning: the text appears in another cell of the table

absent.meaning: the text is nowhere on the page

missing_row.meaning: a reference row inside the table's aligned span has no reader row

outside_table.meaning: the row's text is on the page, outside every table

in_table_elsewhere.meaning: the row's text appears in another cell of the table

absent.meaning: the row's text is nowhere on the page

extra_value.meaning: a reader cell in an aligned row whose text no reference cell of the mapped columns holds

wrong_column.meaning: the row holds the text in a column the reader placed it outside of

wrong_row.meaning: a row within two rows above or below holds the text

misplaced.meaning: the text is elsewhere in the sheet

not_in_workbook.meaning: the text is nowhere in the workbook

unaligned_row.meaning: a reader row inside the table's span that aligns to no reference row

misplaced.meaning: its text is in the sheet, in rows the alignment did not take

not_in_workbook.meaning: its text is nowhere in the workbook

unaligned_table.meaning: a table none of whose cells is in the workbook

no_key_in_workbook.meaning: no cell text of the table appears in any printed sheet

span_mismatch.meaning: an exact cell whose span disagrees with the workbook's merged range

wider.meaning: the reader cell spans more sheet columns than the range

narrower.meaning: the reader cell spans fewer sheet columns than the range

rows.meaning: the reader cell's row span reaches past the range

merged_cells.meaning: one reader cell covering two reference cells of the same row

text_intact.meaning: the cell holds both texts joined in order

text_differs.meaning: the cell's text is not the two texts joined

outside_table.meaning: a workbook cell's text left outside every table

cell_text_outside.meaning: the string outside every table is a reference cell's display text

unexplained_text.meaning: text outside every table that is neither header or footer nor a workbook cell

numeric.meaning: a number the workbook does not hold

edge.meaning: text in the page's margin that matches no header or footer pattern

text.meaning: text in the page's body that the workbook does not hold

unverifiable.meaning: text the PDF shows that no reader of the workbook can check

uncached_formula.meaning: the result of a formula the workbook stores without a cached value

print_area_overflow.meaning: text that overflowed into the page from a cell outside the print area

columns_folded.meaning: a cell read whole and in its row, in a sheet column no reader column maps

unmapped_column.meaning: the print never showed that column beside its neighbour, so the reader folded the two into one

merged_rows.meaning: two rows' cells drawn with no rule between them

text_intact.meaning: read as one cell holding both texts in order

prose_row.meaning: rows of text the workbook never held, printed before the first matched row or after the last

outside_workbook.meaning: a document's title block or footer around the table

uncovered.value_mismatch: the cell was found but its text mismatched everywhere it was found
uncovered.outside_table: its text appeared only outside every table
uncovered.absent: its text was never seen on any page

skipped_tables.pagination: every cell is header or footer text in the page's margin
skipped_tables.continuation: a page past a horizontal page break holding only the ends of cells wider than the page; text, not cells, all of it the workbook's

table_notes.columns_refined: reader columns that refine one sheet column without ever colliding
table_notes.merges_unreported: merged ranges the reader covered only partly

pagination.pagination_lines: runs in the page's margin whose vertical ranges overlap, joined into one line that matches the workbook's header or footer pattern
pagination.lone_page_number_cells: a lone margin cell reading like the header or footer never anchors a row; a sheet cell holding such a value still matches the one sheet row between its neighbours that holds nothing else

taxonomy.rule: a page fails on any error whose subclass is failing; a pair fails when any page fails or any reference cell is uncovered; nothing is a percentage, every miss has a class

limits: Paired renditions are the measurement method, not a prerequisite for reading a production PDF. Cell comparison does not independently establish prose outside tables, raster fidelity, routing correctness, source-locator replay, malicious-document handling, production concurrency, or operational cost and coordinator burden. Those belong to their own tickets.
